$description: Avatar (platform/components/Avatar, library wave 4, extend): the tokens of the presence dot at its corner. The avatar's sizes, corners and colors are in components.tokens.json; the dot's own colors and sizes are StatusDot's.

avatar-presence-ring-color.$description: Avatar presence: the ring around the dot, in the surface color, that separates it from the picture or the initials.

avatar-presence-offset.$description: Avatar presence: how far the ringed dot sits past the avatar's bottom and end edges (the ring's width, negated).

avatar-border-width.$description: Avatar: the 1px border around every avatar, picture or placeholder (owner, 2026-10-19).

avatar-border-color.$description: Avatar: the border's color, the media border role (as around images).
